integrity: The complete exact finite-sum proof is in RESULT.md. A standalone Python checker performs exhaustive prime-field cases and symbolic coefficient consistency checks; finite computation is not the proof.
scientific_limitations: The formula treats a fixed nilpotent matrix with exactly two equal blocks; it does not classify arbitrary Jordan shapes or count conjugacy orbits. The absolute originality search cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent Hall-polynomial statement.
title: Exact Jordan-rank census of square-zero matrices centralizing two equal Jordan blocks
